verdict.rationale: Several pieces of cubic data can be taken out in open formats. Team member analytics export as CSV, the Analytics API returns PR-level data, the AI wiki exports as markdown files into your repo, and review configuration lives in a repo-hosted cubic.yaml. There is no documented comprehensive 'export all data' or offboarding path. Review findings are reachable only through the MCP server, not a bulk export. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export (review history, findings, learnings/memory, chat), account deletion/offboarding guidance, and independent confirmation that exports are complete.
